Just Jump Me to the Details Please!

How it all started:

After 5 years of trying to sell my art through galleries and never making more than $23k, I started an online community in 2017 called Color Crush Creative as a weekly newsletter.

I dedicated a whole year to just building my list and connecting with the community until the day came to launch my membership. That's when everything changed.

My love of marketing and teaching collided into a job I was most suited for - my own art educator business!

And the thing that surprised me the most? In my first year I surpassed six figures.  🤯

This trend only worked upwards from there to making triple that in a very short time. In fact in less than 5 years I earned over a million in revenue with very few expenses. That's when I knew that this was the path I was meant to be on all along. 

How it's going now:

Now I'm passing that knowledge onto you.

For more than 4 years I've been mentoring artists just like you transform their whole businesses into something much, much more profitable.

In fact some of them are now doing better than I did (and I'm very happy for them!) Maybe you know some of these art educators: Cat Rains, Drew Steinbrecher, Susan McCreevy, Tania Ahmed, Wendy Brightbill, Brooke (BB) Henry, Sam Boughton, Susan Yeates, Roben-Marie Smith, Margarete Miller, Delight Rogers, Francisca Nunes, Deni Rayneau, Diana Garrison, Gabriella Buckingham, Sue Bulmer, Sarah Short....

Well, those are just a few. But you can even ask them yourself how my program has helped them. (many have been on my podcast even!) I'm really so happy for their success! And to see my framework in action - It works! And not just for me but for anyone who follows through and puts it into action. 

Could you be next? Could this be the year you finally skyrocket? 

WHY Build it Remarkable is Different:

Build it Remarkable is not like other marketing and business strategy programs, especially the ones from the big digital marketing "gurus"  who's whole goal is to get you in and out the door.

BIR is designed by me, an artist and course creator, who has achieved success on her own terms doing exactly what you want to do.

It's designed by someone who understands our artist industry, the way we need to connect with creatives and their unique language and desires, and especially designed differently because this isn't a course of coaches teaching coaches how to teach coaches (often with no actual experience in the field!)  😂

Instead I have focused on a very specific customer (artists and makers) with very specific needs (wanting to make their creative educator business profitable)  and created a system that you can actually implement and get real results from >>> that's the Builder's Framework.

MODULE 1: Do the Groundwork

Begin with a rock-solid start for your creative business. Let’s turn your vision into reality!

Kick off your journey with an energizing welcome meeting where you'll meet fellow creatives and get a clear roadmap of the steps you need to take. This session sets the stage for everything we'll be working on in Build it Remarkable.

Get a snapshot of your current standing with a thorough business audit. Identify your strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities for growth, and lay the foundation for a stable, lasting educator business.

Learn the first principles in marketing to your ideal client in a way that is authentic to you using an incredibly effective plan I developed called the Prism Marketing Method™. 

You'll also learn the #1 way to gain clarity and growth fast...and it's not what you think!

Get aligned with your vision, your offer and marketing so that business becomes fun again!

MODULE 2: Lay the Foundation

Build Your Foundation to solidify your brand's identity, authority, and reach.

Dive into the heart of your identity and purpose with our signature Creative Core Mapping® process. Uncover your unique strengths, past experiences, and future dreams to craft a business that is authentically you.

Go beyond surface-level understanding and delve deep into your niche. This is the secret sauce of marketing and messaging - you've never done it this way before, I promise!

Uncover your hidden audience to find the untapped market segments that are waiting to discover you. Learn strategies to reach and engage these potential customers, expanding your influence and growing your business.

Anchor your business with our Keystone™ framework, focusing on the 5 essential questions you need to know if you're going to attract customers.

Finally understand effective messaging so you can communicate with your ideal market effectively and and turn them into raving fans!

MODULE 3: Build Your Framework

Create your unique business model and learn how to design irresistible offers.

Create a program that integrates all the facets of your remarkable self while maintaining a laser focus on your core offering. Discover strategies to design a cohesive and compelling business model that aligns with your vision and goals.

Identify and develop your unique frameworks and intellectual property. These proprietary methods and processes set you apart from the competition and form the backbone of your offerings.

Learn how to gather the most important data on your offer by launching a beta version before you create your whole offer. The magic is in the testing and trial phase so you are set up for success later!

Discover the secrets to crafting irresistible offers with our Offer Building Blocks™ framework. Learn how to package and present your offers in a way that captivates your audience and drives conversions.

MODULE 4: Construct a Simple System

This is where it we get to create the most effective marketing plan and it's actually really simple! 

Learn how to communicate with your audience so that they become raving fans. Build your authority and be known for what you do.

Uncover the essence of your Primary Content Machine™ (PCM)—the engine that drives your content creation and marketing.

Supercharge your business by growing your email list with a compelling Juicy Lead Magnet™. Learn to create an irresistible free offer that attracts and converts high-quality leads.

Keep your audience engaged with a well-crafted newsletter. Learn how to stay connected, deliver value, and maintain a strong relationship with your subscribers.

You'll be able to identify and understand the characteristics of engaged leads. 

MODULE 5: Wired for Growth

Expand your reach through effective content creation, collaborations and messaging

Elevate your Primary Content Machine™ to new heights. Implement advanced strategies and techniques to optimize your content creation and learn methods for easy repurposing.

Expand your reach by tapping into other people’s audiences. Learn the importance of PR and collaborations, and discover strategies to leverage these opportunities for maximum impact. 

Organize your content with well-defined categories based on your brand pillars. Develop a robust planning and strategy framework to ensure consistent and strategic content delivery.

Start  Serving Your Customer and Community Now. Discover ways to serve your customers and community effectively. Focus on providing immediate value and support to meet their needs and enhance their experience with you.

MODULE 6: Cement Your Success

Learn to ask for the sale confidently, price effectively, and execute successful launches. 

Master the art of asking for the sale with confidence and authenticity. Learn techniques to make the sales process feel natural and value-driven, ensuring both you and your customer feel good about the transaction.

Unlock the secrets to effective pricing strategies. Understand how to price your products and services to reflect their true value, attract your ideal customers, and maximize profitability.

Discover the keys to a successful launch. Learn how to create buzz and demand for your offer, ensuring your launch is a resounding success. From pre-launch excitement to post-launch momentum, we've got you covered.

More Details About the Program:

Will I learn to make art in this program?

Build it Remarkable is intended for artists who are already proficient and know their style and have already started a creative business. We do NOT learn how to make art in the program, we learn how to leverage our talent to build a Creative Educator Business.

Will I learn how to sell my art?

This Program does not teach methods to sell art or get into galleries. We learn how to build and market an educator business using your expertise to create courses, a membership, workshops and collaborations, and we will reinforce the skills needed to sell better than ever before through your own uniquely designed offers.

Will I learn how to create a digital course?

You will learn the foundation to building a business, including how to design the perfect offer. While we might discuss what is possible for tech and course hosting, this program does NOT specifically go into tech - like how to record, edit or make your digital course. Everyone has different business models and we can't cover every possibility. We do provide a tech bundle course as a bonus for you to learn some of the skills need to create videos on your own time.

I'm not a visual artist, will this work for me?

Build it Remarkable is a one-of-a-kind creative business accelerator that will give ANY creative expert the foundation they need to finally build a profitable business. It doesn't matter your medium - music, yoga, graphic design, poetry, fiber arts, spiritual guide, underwater basket weaving - if you are ready to think outside the box and build something truly remarkable, then this is the program for you!

What if I can't make the calls or workshops?

We record all masterclasses and coaching calls and will keep all trainings and workshops indefinitely, and coaching or meetup calls for a minimum of 3 months for you to refer back to on your own time. It's wonderful for you to be present whenever possible, but we know that you might not be available for everything.  Because everyone lives in different times zones, have busy lives, and are busy working on their business, we create a variety of times and days for calls and meetups in hopes that you'll find an event that matches your schedule.

How long do I get to keep the content?

You get lifetime* access to all the CORE content, such as the modules and bonuses and any updates we make to the program. We will keep coaching or meetup calls for a minimum of 3 months for you to refer back to on your own time. *lifetime means for as long as the school is in operation. Please refer to term & conditions.

How many people will be accepted into the program?

This program has limited enrollment We will cut off the first cohort of 2026 at a maximum of 80 new Builders. This fosters a close community and allows us to get to know each student and meet them where they're at. 

What if I don't know what kind of business I want yet?

Do you have an expertise in something creative? Are you proficient in your passion? Do you already spend hours and hours working on the thing you love the most? Then there's no doubt we can extract your genius and put together a great business plan. You don't have to have it all figured out, you just have to start!

Do I get access to all the content as soon as I join?

We are teaching Build it Remarkable LIVE again this year! Everything is recorded and edited for clarity and then saved in your Builder's Hub. Most of the content is dripped out over time. But you will get instant access to some Jumpstart lessons, the Tech Bundle, and the community, of course!

How much is the investment?

This is a highly specialized course to teach you all the marketing tools you need to succeed in your new creative business. The price reflects the care and attention you will receive so that you can grow your business.. Currently Build it Remarkable is a 12 month program of ongoing community and support and the investment is only $2400 usd for a whole year of training and support!

Is this really a good time to be running a business with all that's happening in the world?

There's no time like right now. The world is always in chaos and sometimes really challenging, but taking control of your future and helping others find art is a big way that you can make a difference, not only for you but for our community. We need Builders more than ever! Listen to The Made Remarkable Podcast, episodes 136 & 137.

What if I want a refund?

Please be thoughtful about the commitment you are about to make. We have a case by case refund policy for a program like this. If you decide within the first 14 days from program start day that this is not your ideal fit, please be prepared to show that you have watched the lessons and done the homework and provide a reasonable answer as to why this is not a good fit for you.  We have a $100 refund service fee.
